sahneler.metin: Over the San Gabriel Mountains, an airliner and a Marine fighter collided.
Both crashed, killing all forty nine aboard the DC-9 and the fighter's pilot.
The fighter was flying under visual flight rules.
It wasn't in contact with civilian controllers.
The airliner was climbing out of Los Angeles.
Neither crew saw the other in time.
The fighter's radar officer ejected and survived.
Military jets were then required to contact civilian controllers.

aciklama:
Hughes Airwest 706 collided with a military jet over the San Gabriel Mountains. The cause: midair collision where neither crew saw the other in time and the fighter wasn't under radar control.
